title: Oracle disagreement
description: How far Pyth, Chainlink and the CF benchmark are from each other on BTC. They rarely agree to the cent, and a wide gap usually means one is stale.

state.label: Oracle state
state.description: Aligned when the oracles agree within a threshold, divergent when they do not. Divergent means the settlement price is uncertain.

dispersion_bps.label: Oracle gap
dispersion_bps.description: The gap between the highest and lowest oracle as a share of price, in basis points. Bigger means more disagreement.

leading_oracle.label: Leading
leading_oracle.description: The oracle that moved first on the latest move. The others are expected to follow.

lagging_oracle.label: Lagging
lagging_oracle.description: The oracle furthest behind the latest move. If it settles a venue, that venue is briefly mispriced.
